biggest_catch: The 'up to $2,200' is a conditional maximum, not a guarantee: you must be 18+ with untreated hypertension or on stable therapy with at most 2 antihypertensive meds, pass medical screening, and complete the full visit schedule for the hypertension study.
catches: 'Compensation up to $2,200' is a conditional maximum: payout depends on visits completed.
Medical screening gate: 18+, untreated hypertension OR on stable therapy with up to 2 antihypertensive medications - not everyone qualifies.
Investigational treatment study with real medical risks disclosed in informed consent; routine monitoring and possible short stays at the research center.
Time commitment: screening plus a series of study visits; travel to the Alliance Research Institute site required.

c1.evidence: Alliance Research Institute is a real clinical research site (Costa Mesa, CA area) running current enrolling studies; allianceresearchinstitute.com is its official domain.

c2.evidence: Official Ongoing Clinical Studies page states 'compensation up to $2,200' for the hypertension study with qualification criteria (18+, untreated hypertension or stable therapy with up to 2 antihypertensive medications).

c3.evidence: No fee to participate; participants receive study-related exams, medication, and care at no cost plus reimbursement/compensation.

c4.evidence: Compensation ceiling and qualification criteria stated on the official current-studies page.

eligibility: 18 years or older with untreated hypertension or on stable therapy with up to 2 antihypertensive medications; must pass screening.
notes: Alliance Research Institute official Ongoing Clinical Studies page, verified live 2026-09-23: hypertension (high blood pressure) study - 'Qualified volunteers may receive: Reimbursement for time and travel, compensation up to $2,200.' steps: Open the Alliance Research Institute Ongoing Clinical Studies page and locate the High Blood Pressure (Hypertension) Study.
Contact Alliance Research to apply and schedule a screening.
Pass the medical screening (18+, untreated hypertension or stable therapy with up to 2 antihypertensive medications).
Complete the study visit schedule per the protocol.
Receive reimbursement for time and travel plus compensation of up to $2,200.
timing: Compensation/reimbursement paid for time and travel in connection with study participation; exact per-visit schedule explained at enrollment.
